articles.title: 消費税減税 自民内税率1％案で進めるべきの意見も 首相判断へ
articles.japanese_title: 消費税(しょうひぜい)減税(げんぜい) 自民(じみん)内(ない)税率(ぜい率)1％(いっ％)案(あん)で(で)進める(すすめる)べき(べき)の(の)意見(いけん)も(も) 首相(しゅしょう)判断(はんだん)へ(へ)
articles.english_summary: A revised proposal for the intermediate summary of the consumption tax reduction has been presented, but no consensus was reached in the practical session of the cross-party 'National Conference'. Within the LDP, there are opinions suggesting that a plan to lower the tax rate by 1% for two years starting next April should be implemented, with the Prime Minister expected to make a decision soon.
